record.question: Which among the following is not correct under the Mizo Marriage, Divorce and Inheritance of Property Act, 2014?
options: A person of sound mind who has attained majority under the law in force, while he/she is fully possessed of his/her clear conscience capable of exercising his/her free will may execute will in writing in the presence of at least two witnesses as to how all or some or part of his/her property which he/she can alienate during his/her life time be disposed after his/her death.
The making of a will caused by coercion, threat, intimidation or undue influence or fraud is void.
The legatee must have attained majority under the law in force and they must be of sound mind.
The testator and the witnesses must put their signatures to the will in the presence of all of them.
record.explanation: Cited PDF page and legal knowledge support this option.
